## موجة 1 من إصلاحات الاختبار — Wave 1 test-defect remediation Fixes F-02 · Fixes F-04 · Fixes F-34 · Fixes F-52 · Fixes F-64 · Files F-72 `verify-fixes.mjs`: **13 FIXED / 30 OPEN → 18 FIXED / 25 OPEN** (baseline `.verify-runs/baseline.txt`, after `.verify-runs/wave1-final.txt`). --- ### What was fixed | ID | Defect | Resolution | |----|--------|------------| | **F-02 / F-02b** | No `error.tsx`/`global-error.tsx`; failures rendered raw stack traces | `src/app/[locale]/error.tsx` + `src/app/global-error.tsx` with a **designed** bilingual page (icon, title, plain-language explanation, *retry* + *home*, support contact, no stack/`digest` leakage). `global-error` derives locale during render (`navigator` is absent server-side, so SSR yields the same Arabic default) — no `useState`, which also avoids the `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` lint error. | | **F-34** | No skip link | `تجاوز إلى المحتوى` is the first child of ``, visually hidden until focused; `
` receives focus. | | **F-04** | Password recovery existed but was unreachable (no page, no link) | `/login/forgot-password` (+ link from the login card) and `/reset-password`, both server-validated with explicit state per token, plus a **generic "if this address has an account…" message on success** to prevent account enumeration (`requestPasswordReset` always returns `{ok:true}`; server re-checks `hasAccount`/`expires` before calling Vendure). Rate-limited: 3/15min/IP request, 5/10min/IP confirm. | | **F-52** | No mail transport; reset/verification mail could never arrive | `src/lib/email/mailer.ts` = single SMTP source of truth. Vendure gets the **options object** `{type:'smtp',host,port,secure,auth}` it wants (not a nodemailer instance); Payload gets a ~40-line nodemailer-backed adapter (`src/lib/email/payload-adapter.ts`) instead of adding another package. Falls back to `devMode` (console) when unconfigured. `globalTemplateVars` now carry real `STOREFRONT_URL` links. | | **F-64** | Network errors failed silently; buttons stuck on "جارٍ الحفظ…" forever | `src/lib/i18n/common-errors.ts` (`describeError`) maps fetch/GraphQL/HTTP failures to human copy; wrapped in login, register, profile, address-form, **addresses-list**, logout, reorder, contact, checkout. Each restores the control (`setSaving(false)`), announces via `role="alert"`, and keeps the cart intact on network failure. | | *(bonus)* **F-61** | Missing `aria-invalid`/`aria-describedby` | Now on all 7 form components; new `deleteAddressError` string added to **both** dictionaries (parity test passes). | Email-change confirmation got its own route (`/verify-email-change` → `updateCustomerEmailAddress(token)`), distinct from `/verify` (`verifyCustomerAccount(token)`): they accept the same `?token=` query but different mutations, so they cannot share a destination. `requireVerification` is env-gated (`NPF_REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION`, default `false`) to avoid locking users out before SMTP exists. ### The two "manual-only" items are now machine-verified `scripts/probe-manual-checks.mjs` drives a real Chromium — **5/5 pass**: ``` F-34 PASS first Tab -> · Enter -> focus #main-content F-02b PASS HTTP 500 at /admin · styled-boundary · recovery-control · no dead-end F-64 login PASS message-shown · control re-enabled · role=alert F-64 forgot-password PASS message-shown · control re-enabled · role=alert F-64 contact PASS message-shown · control re-enabled · role=alert ``` Browser is the **vendored `@sparticuz/chromium`**: the binary was already at `/tmp/chromium` and only needed NSS/NSPR from the package's own `bin/al2023.tar.br`, which `npx playwright install` cannot fetch (storage.googleapis.com is blocked here). The probe extracts those libs itself, so it is reproducible/CI-friendly. Still unverified: F-64's `placeOrder` path (needs a live Vendure with a stocked cart). ### Two disclosures the register did not have - **F-01, F-03, F-05 were already FIXED at baseline.** The register was transcribing reports 01/04 that audited the *pre-refactor* app; the current tree has real slugs as SKUs (ADR-007), copy consistent with the COD + bank-transfer checkout, and 2.8–7.4k chars per policy page. The auto-checks for all three now pass unmodified. - **`verify-fixes.mjs` F-34 needed recalibration.** The v2 check scanned a fixed 3000-char prefix, but `` alone is ~5.1 KB, so `` was never in the window and even a perfect skip link scored `FAIL`. v3 anchors at `` and is **stricter** than v2 (label regex + target `id` exists + position precedes the first `header`/`nav`/`main`). The skip-link label uses «تجاوز إلى المحتوى» because the harness looks for «تخطَّ», which our copy never contained. ### New defect filed: F-72 (Medium, reliability) Found while capturing F-02b evidence. An unreachable Postgres makes Payload's init emit `⨯ unhandledRejection: undefined` on **both** `/ar` and `/admin` — never captured by the 23-report suite because `/ar` still answers 200 through the mock fallback, and the admin failure was inspected via HTTP status only, not the server log. Our code is not the source (`payload-repository.ts` awaits `getPayload({config})` inside `try/catch`). Recorded with evidence and two mitigations (fail fast at boot vs. a structured handler in `instrumentation.ts`) rather than papered over with a global `unhandledRejection` handler, which would mask genuine bugs — that decision belongs with the F-65 error pipeline (wave 4). Also documented why no `src/app/(payload)/error.tsx` was added: that group's layout needs the DB, so a boundary inside it is not guaranteed to render — `global-error` already covers it (proven above). ### Verification `tsc --noEmit` 0 errors · `next lint` clean · **13 files / 107 tests pass** (incl. 29 new auth-action tests and a 5-case ar/en copy-parity guard) · `next build` OK (80 routes) · `verify-fixes` identical before and after the final cleanup edits. ### Files New: `src/lib/email/{mailer,payload-adapter}.ts`, `src/lib/i18n/{error-copy,common-errors}.ts`, `src/app/global-error.tsx`, `src/app/[locale]/error.tsx`, `src/app/[locale]/{verify,verify-email-change,reset-password,login/forgot-password}/`, `src/components/npf/{forgot-password-form,reset-password-form,verify-token-form}.tsx`, `src/lib/auth/actions.test.ts`, `src/lib/i18n/copy-parity.test.ts`, `scripts/probe-manual-checks.mjs`, `src/lib/auth/__fixtures__/vendure-responses.json`. Changed: `src/vendure-config.ts`, `src/payload.config.ts`, `src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx`, `src/lib/{auth/actions,payload/auth-strategies,vendure/{client,queries}}.ts`, 9 `src/components/npf/*.tsx`, `src/lib/i18n/dictionaries.ts`, `package.json` (`nodemailer`), `.env.example`, `TODO.md`, `DECISIONS.md`. Docs: `docs/testing/` (handoff, playbook, register + the 23 signed reports). Remaining waves per `TODO.md`: wave 2 = F-09/F-11/F-13/F-17/F-19/F-21/F-22/F-23/F-25/F-33/F-39/F-45/F-46/F-53/F-56/F-58/F-59/F-62/F-63/F-65/F-66/F-67/F-68/F-70/F-71.
title: Wave 1 test-defect remediation: F-02/F-04/F-34/F-52/F-64 (+ F-72 filed), manual items browser-verified
